name: HoloVAM
definition: A volumetric additive manufacturing technique that uses holographic phase modulation to project light patterns into a photocurable resin, improving light efficiency and allowing 3D digital control of the light beam (e.g., depth of focus, scattering mitigation) compared to amplitude-based TVAM.
summary: HoloVAM is a volumetric additive manufacturing technique that uses holographic phase modulation to achieve higher light efficiency and extended depth of focus compared to amplitude-based methods.
